name: Milio
title: The Gentle Flame

Q.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
Q.description: Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing 80/140/200/260/320 + 1.2×AP magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by 0.4/0.45/0.5/0.55/0.6 + 0.001×AP for 1.5 seconds. Hitting at least one enemy champion with Ultra Mega Fire Kick refunds 50% of it's Mana cost.
Q.summary: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.

W.name: Cozy Campfire
W.description: Milio creates a hearth that follows ally champions for 6 seconds. Ally champions nearby gain 0.1/0.125/0.15/0.175/0.2 Attack Range and restore 70/90/110/130/150 + 0.15×AP Health over the duration. The hearth also applies Fired Up! every 3 seconds. Recast: Change the hearth's follow ally.
W.summary: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.

E.name: Warm Hugs
E.description: Milio wraps an ally champion in protective flames, granting 45/75/105/135/165 + 0.45×AP Shield and 12/14.0/16/18/20% Move Speed for 2.5 seconds. This ability has 2 charges and the effects stack on repeat targets.
E.summary: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.

R.name: Breath of Life
R.description: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames on nearby ally champions, cleansing Disabling and Immobilizing effects, restoring 150/250/350 + 0.5×AP Health, and granting 65% Tenacity for 3 seconds.
R.summary: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.

Passive.name: Fired Up!
Passive.description: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.
Passive.summary: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Enchanter who shields and heals allies and protects them from crowd control with R. Wins lane with Q knockback poke and supports carry trades.
strengths: R cleanses crowd control and heals allies
Q knocks back enemies and slows
E shield and move speed for allies
W extends ally range and heals
weaknesses: Q is his only crowd control

R.notes: Cleanses crowd control from allies; heals.

profile.windowAgainst: R on cooldown: engage his team.
